name: subscribe__negotiation_request_response
description: Drives the IM:Subscribe negotiation end-to-end: peer ships SubscribeRequest → bridge replies with the initial ReportData (possibly chunked, each chunk requiring a per-chunk StatusResponse from the peer per F5/F6 fixes) → bridge ships SubscribeResponse with the negotiated subscriptionId + MaxInterval. The harness asserts the SubscribeResponse arrives on the same peer-opened exchange the request used. Locks the F5 (per-chunk handshake) and F6 (MRP piggyback-ack per chunk) regressions at scenario level — without those, Apple Home sees the initial Subscribe transaction time out before SubscribeResponse arrives.
